function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### The “Best” Men’s Underwear Styles – What Fits Which Lifestyle? | Style | What It Looks Like | Key Features | Best For | Pros | Cons | |-------|--------------------|--------------|----------|------|------| | **Briefs** | Classic “shorty” with a snug waistband and full coverage at the front. | Tight fit, high waistband, no leg coverage. | Everyday wear, office, light activity. | • Great support, minimal bulk.
• Easy to pair with any pants. | • Can feel restrictive for tall or muscular thighs.
• Not ideal for long runs or heavy workouts. | | **Boxers** | Loose, long‑legged, relaxed fit. | Wide waistband, no front support. | Casual, sleepwear, lounging. | • Breathable, comfortable.
• No pressure on the groin. | • Lack of support for active use.
• Can bunch up under tight pants. | | **Boxer Briefs** | Hybrid: snug like briefs, longer legs like boxers. | Mid‑rise, supportive, no leg coverage. | Workouts, travel, everyday. | • Combines support & coverage.
• Minimal bunching. | • Can feel tight if not sized right. | | **Trunks** | Shorter leg than boxer briefs, mid‑rise. | Similar to boxer briefs but with a shorter leg. | Gym, running, fashion‑forward looks. | • Sleek profile, less bulk.
• Good for tight pants. | • Less coverage for taller men. | | **Jockstrap** | Supportive cup with a waistband and a thin elastic strap. | Minimal fabric, high support. | Sports, cycling, high‑impact activities. | • Excellent support, minimal chafing.
• Keeps everything in place. | • Not suitable for everyday wear. | | **Compression Briefs** | Tight, full‑coverage briefs with compression fabric. | Elastic waistband, high compression. | Recovery, long flights, high‑intensity training. | • Improves circulation, reduces muscle fatigue.
• Keeps everything snug. | • Can feel too tight if over‑compressed. | | **Bamboo/Organic Cotton** | Any style made from eco‑friendly fibers. | Soft, breathable, moisture‑wicking. | Sensitive skin, eco‑conscious shoppers. | • Hypoallergenic, sustainable.
• Good for hot climates. | • May wrinkle or shrink; requires careful care. | | **Performance Tech (e.g., Dri‑Fit, Coolmax)** | Usually boxer briefs or trunks. | Moisture‑wicking, anti‑odor, quick‑dry. | Athletes, hot climates. | • Keeps you dry, reduces odor.
• Lightweight. | • Can be pricier; may feel less natural. | --- ## How to Pick the Right Style 1. **Consider Your Activity Level** * **Low‑impact / everyday** → Briefs or boxer briefs. * **High‑impact / sports** → Jockstrap or compression briefs. * **Travel / long flights** → Compression briefs or performance boxer briefs. 2. **Think About Comfort & Fit** * **Tall or muscular thighs** → Boxer briefs or trunks with a higher waistband. * **Sensitive skin** → Bamboo or organic cotton; avoid rough seams. 3. **Look at the Fabric** * **Cotton** – Soft, breathable, but can absorb sweat. * **Polyester/Spandex blends** – Stretchy, moisture‑wicking, durable. * **Bamboo** – Eco‑friendly, naturally antibacterial. * **Silk** – Luxurious, smooth, but less durable. 4. **Check the Waistband** * **Elastic waistband** – Comfortable, stays in place. * **Non‑elastic** – Can be more supportive but may shift. 5. **Try Different Brands & Sizes** * Brands like **Calvin Klein**, **Hanes**, **Uniqlo**, **Saxx**, **Under Armour**, and **Lululemon** offer a range of fits. * Always read sizing charts; many brands have a “slim”, “regular”, or “athletic” fit. --- ## Quick Style Guide | Situation | Recommended Style | Why | |-----------|-------------------|-----| | **Office / Formal** | Briefs or boxer briefs | Keeps you looking neat, minimal bulk. | | **Gym / Running** | Performance boxer briefs or trunks | Supports muscles, wicks sweat. | | **Cycling** | Jockstrap or compression briefs | Keeps everything in place, reduces chafing. | | **Travel** | Compression briefs | Reduces swelling, keeps you comfortable. | | **Sleep / Lounging** | Boxers or bamboo briefs | Breathable, relaxed fit. | | **Hot Climate** | Performance cotton or bamboo | Keeps you cool, reduces odor. | | **Cold Climate** | Thermal briefs or wool blends | Adds warmth without bulk. | --- ## Top Picks (2026) | Brand | Style | Best For | Price Range | |-------|-------|----------|-------------| | **Saxx** | **Vibe** (boxer briefs) | Everyday, travel | $30–$40 | | **Calvin Klein** | **Classic Brief** | Office, casual | $25–$35 | | **Uniqlo** | **AIRism Boxer Brief** | Performance, hot climates | $15–$25 | | **Under Armour** | **UA Tech** (compression briefs) | Recovery, long flights | $35–$45 | | **Lululemon** | **ABC** (anti‑bunch) | Workouts, everyday | $45–$55 | | **Bamboo Body** | **Bamboo Boxer Brief** | Sensitive skin, eco‑friendly | $20–$30 | | **Jockey** | **Jockstrap** | Sports, cycling | $20–$30 | --- ### Final Tips - **Fit is king**: Even the best style will feel uncomfortable if it’s too tight or too loose. - **Rotate**: Having 3–4 pairs of each style keeps them fresh and reduces wear. - **Care**: Follow washing instructions—most performance fabrics need cold water and no bleach; cotton can be tumble‑dried on low heat. Happy underwear hunting!
